title: Widget and Gadget buyers with no returns
prompt: Return the customer_name (column: customer_name) of customers who purchased both 'Widget' and 'Gadget' (combine the two product subqueries with INTERSECT), excluding any customer who has ever filed a return, checked using a correlated NOT EXISTS subquery against the returns table.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE purchases (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, customer_name TEXT, product TEXT); INSERT INTO purchases VALUES (1,1,'Petra Voss','Widget'),(2,1,'Petra Voss','Gadget'),(3,2,'Quinn Ashby','Widget'),(4,2,'Quinn Ashby','Gadget'),(5,3,'Reid Solano','Widget'),(6,3,'Reid Solano','Sprocket'),(7,4,'Sana Kade','Gadget'),(8,4,'Sana Kade','Widget'); CREATE TABLE returns (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, item TEXT); INSERT INTO returns VALUES (1,2,'Gadget');
reference_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM purchases p1 WHERE product = 'Widget' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.customer_id = p1.customer_id) INTERSECT SELECT customer_name FROM purchases p2 WHERE product = 'Gadget' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.customer_id = p2.customer_id);
